article-meta.title: Taxonomy of Colletotrichum from a synthetic corpus

body.p: Colletotrichum is a large genus. Colletotrichum species cause anthracnose. Colletotrichum taxonomy was revised. Colletotrichum strains were examined. Colletotrichum cultures were deposited. Colletotrichum sequences were generated.
Colletotrichum alpha (F. Liu & L. Cai) comb. nov. Typus: China, Yunnan, on leaves, 2016 (holotype HMAS 350001, ex-type culture CGMCC 3.20511 = LC13811 = NN000011).
Colletotrichum gamma F. Liu, sp. nov. Typus: China, Fujian, on leaves, 2018 (holotype HMAS 350003, ex-type culture CGMCC 3.20502 = LC13803).
